field_provenance.samples.observed.x,z: observed: chunk position and column offset
field_provenance.samples.observed.surface_y: observed: decoded WORLD_SURFACE minus one plus minimum Y
field_provenance.samples.observed.ocean_floor_y: observed: decoded OCEAN_FLOOR; Minecraft motion-blocking semantics, not bare geological floor
field_provenance.samples.observed.biome: observed: biome palette at WORLD_SURFACE height, 4x4x4 cell
field_provenance.samples.observed.exposed_y: derived: descending column with explicit vegetation-name exclusion
field_provenance.samples.observed.water: observed water/kelp/seagrass/bubble_column name at derived exposed_y; does not include ice or arbitrary waterlogged blocks
field_provenance.samples.observed.water_y: observed Y of water-like exposed block; null when absent
field_provenance.cells.elevation: derived: mean exposed_y of five columns in one sampled chunk per 64x64 cell
field_provenance.cells.slope: derived: maximum absolute elevation difference to four neighbor cells divided by 64, rise/run, not angle
field_provenance.cells.relief: derived: max minus min mean elevation within 7x7 cells
field_provenance.cells.roughness: derived: population standard deviation of five exposed_y values within sampled chunk
field_provenance.cells.biome: derived: dominant biome among five sampled columns
field_provenance.cells.water: derived: water presence fraction among five sampled columns
field_provenance.cells.terrain,geo_id: derived: ordered thresholds then 4-neighbor connected components
field_provenance.objects.details.estimated_area_blocks2: derived: 4096 times member count; extrapolated, including boundary cell overhang
field_provenance.objects.SITE: interpretive: natural-space potential only, no Canon

terrain_rules_in_order: wetlands_candidate: dominant biome identifier contains swamp or marsh; biome-context-only candidate
mountains_candidate: mean exposed Y>=150 and 7x7 relief>=65
plateau_candidate: mean exposed Y>=120, slope<0.12, within-chunk roughness<3
valley_candidate: local relative elevation<=-18 and relief>=45
hills_candidate: residual terrestrial class; may include forest and mixed terrain

spatial_relationships.geo_at_coordinate: first verify chunk existence, then cells by floor(x/64),floor(z/64); membership is a derived cell assignment
spatial_relationships.adjacency: undirected GEO pairs and shared 64-grid edge count
spatial_relationships.feature_associations: join active objects through overlapping members; do not join by bounding-box containment
spatial_relationships.identity: family prefix and monotonic integer, same-type previous member Jaccard>=0.35 preserves ID; retired IDs remain inactive

generation_scope: all region location tables and all chunk Status/DataVersion; block and biome palettes decoded only for selected full chunks
incremental_policy: region SHA256 and algorithm version gate sample reuse; all derived data regenerated
